text:
sam: Quick check-in: starting a privilege-minimization sweep for the next 2 weeks. Targets: Console admin roles, KMS key admins, SSO groups, service accounts. If you own any of those, pls post any exemptions or current migration work.
maria: Do we have an updated mapping of roles -> AWS IAM/KMS principals? I can run a JIT entitlement report but need the mapping or CSV export.
ash?: (typo) ash: I exported current RBAC CSV from console and dropped it in #eng-security-files. It has columns: role, members, source (okta/aws/console), last_modified.
security-bot: Automated report uploaded: 12 KMS keys with >3 admins. Report path: /reports/kms-admins-2026-11-05.csv.
jordan: Flagging vuln triage: svc-account `encoder-worker` still has broad `kms:Decrypt` on prod keys. Assigning owner @ash to narrow scope. High blast radius if compromised.
ash?: (typo) ash: On it. Proposed policy to scope decrypts to a single key + EncryptionContext condition. Example snippet:
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/0123abcd",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:EncryptionContext:app": "encoder"}}
}
```
maria: We should also adopt short-lived creds and rotate service-account keys. Can we onboard these svc accounts to Vault JIT issuance? @ops-tim
ops-tim: We have a pilot for JIT secrets in Vault. I can expand to encoder svc by EOD Friday if no infra blockers. Will raise a PR for the role template.
sam: For KMS admins: please file tickets with current justification + expected duration. Use template: 1) resource, 2) principal(s), 3) reason, 4) fallback plan + rollback test. We'll auto-close stale admin entitlements older than 90 days unless ticketed.
jordan: :eyes: I'll add the encoder scoping ticket and link it to the vuln board (VULN-321).
security-bot: Reminder: periodic access reviews scheduled. Affected groups: infra-admins, model-ops-admins, billing-admins. Review window opens 2026-11-08.
nash?: (typo) ash: Quick ask: when you prune admins, can we run a smoke-test playbook against prod-kv and model-store to validate no service regressions? I can author the playbook and run it in the canary window.
maria: Agree. Add a canary + rollback policy in each ticket and a contact list for 1hr post-prune.
sam: Plan accepted. Owners: KMS admin cleanup -> maria; service account scoping -> ash; JIT onboarding -> ops-tim; tickets due by 2026-11-07. Quick standup tomorrow 10:00am PST to triage blockers. :shipit:
